verdict.rationale: Capsule's feature page shows native, in-product reports with charts that can be filtered by time period, user or team, so basic reporting doesn't require a spreadsheet. The pack never says which metrics those reports cover or that Capsule has its own dashboards; the dashboard claim relies on the external Data Studio tool, which earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented pipeline, activity and conversion report types, a native dashboard builder, report customization depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Filter reports based on time periods, users or teams for a clearer picture.
Export all of your report data or save an image of your chart for import into other tools such as Excel.
